remarks: Enjoy the opportunity to own a .30-acre parcel in a peaceful country setting on French Road in Bennington. This level, rectangular property offers approximately 123 feet of road frontage and 111 feet of depth. An old schoolhouse once stood on the property and has been mostly removed. Enjoy the peaceful country setting while still being within an easy drive to area amenities—approximately 15 minutes to Darien Lake Theme Park & Amphitheater, 17 minutes to Warsaw, and 27 minutes to Batavia. Bring your ideas and explore the possibilities this property has to offer!
